canonical_development_stage.description: Canonical dashboard classification. Confirmed current wording/milestones may be normalized; plans, expectations, financing, hiring, and adjacent programs must not be promoted to a current stage.

schema_version.description: Fast Triage v3.2 output must use 3.2. Full Scout retains its existing schema version because its JSON shape did not change. Older values remain readable for stored legacy records.

instruction_version.description: 3.2 for current Fast Triage output; 3.3 for current Full Scout output.

generated_at.description: Date the underlying GPT report/search was produced. Defaults to today (UTC) on save if missing.

rubric_version.description: Rubric/guideline version used to score this record (full-scout or fast-triage rubric depending on workflow).

rescored_rubric_version.description: Set only by the detail page's 'Score 기준 갱신' button (POST /api/records/{id}/refresh-rubric) when OpenRouter finds clear evidence to update this single record's scores. rubric_version above always stays the original GPT-search-time version; this field chains forward from it (or from the previous rescored_rubric_version) via next_minor_version, e.g. 3.1 -> 3.2 -> 3.3. v1 scope: single-record only — does not bump SCORING_CRITERIA_VERSION or other records.

rescored_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the most recent successful rubric refresh.

rescored_by.description: Actor IP of the most recent successful rubric refresh (temporary stand-in for user identity, same convention as last_edited_by).

rubric_reviewed_version.description: Latest rubric version against which the stored scores were successfully reviewed, whether or not a score changed.

rubric_reviewed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the latest valid, non-conflicting rubric review.

rubric_reviewed_by.description: Actor IP of the latest valid, non-conflicting rubric review.

rubric_review_result.description: Whether the latest successful rubric review changed official scores or retained them.

rubric_refresh_history.description: Append-only log of valid, non-conflicting rubric reviews on this record, newest last and capped at 20 entries.

last_edited_at.description: Derived ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the newest edit_history event whose field is exactly source_report.raw_markdown. Full Scout load/save normalization removes stale values when no such event exists; general Team Review activity never updates this field.

last_edited_by.description: Derived identifier from the newest source_report.raw_markdown audit event. actor_name is preferred and actor_ip remains the technical fallback until SSO is wired up; the UI presents loopback IPs as Local workspace and rubric recalculation events as the rubric version.

edit_history.description: Append-only log of human/dashboard edits, newest last and capped at 200 entries server-side. Exact source_report.raw_markdown events drive GPT source/score revision metadata; all other entries are shown in the Team Review workspace history.

actor_ip.description: Requester IP address, temporary stand-in for user identity until SSO is available.

actor_name.description: Reviewer-entered name or employee ID. Preferred for the visible audit trail when present; actor_ip remains as a technical fallback.

source.description: Which UI/endpoint made the change, e.g. detail_json_editor, dashboard_table_manual_review, dashboard_tab3_focus_management, dashboard_comment, dashboard_attachment_upload, dashboard_attachment_delete, dashboard_qualitative_review, paste_json_upsert.

human_review.description: Manual score/status overrides layered on top of AI baseline values. overrides.status_reason stores the editable one-line human rationale shown beside Review status; both status and rationale changes are audit-logged.

focus_management.description: TAB3/full-scout review workspace state. OI Partnership v1.0 stores an auto-classified or human-overridden partnership_type (investment|value_up|joint_research|n_a|unknown), partnership_note, evidence sources, source/status, and the auto suggestion. Also supports partner material flags and the in_vivo_status/in_vitro_status/admet_completed evidence-summary triple.

partnership_type.description: Final Filter 3 value. Automatic rules use target indication, modality, stage, in-vivo/in-vitro outcome, ADMET score, and Platform Attractiveness. A human selection takes precedence until Auto is selected again. Empty is accepted only for legacy/untracked records before classification.

partnership_note.description: Applied rule, overlap, missing-field list, or N/A reason shown immediately to the right of Filter 3.

partnership_evidence_sources.description: Tab3 structured data, Tab2 report, and uploaded filenames used for the final classification.

partnership_auto_suggestion.description: Latest v1.0 automatic suggestion retained even when the final partnership_type is manually overridden.

partner_material_flags.description: Human-maintained availability indicators for CDP, NCDP, and ADMET partner materials. The detail UI also derives effective active states only from standalone CDP, NCDP, or ADMET tokens in uploaded attachment filenames; an automatic match does not overwrite these manual booleans.

partner_material_flag_overrides.description: Explicit human overrides for CDP, NCDP, and ADMET availability. When a boolean exists for a key, it takes precedence over filename auto-detection so a user can manually switch the indicator on or off.

in_vivo_status.description: Whether an explicit in-vivo outcome was found in the GPT report + uploaded attachments. O requires positive efficacy/activity wording, X requires negative/failure wording, and N/A means absent or outcome unclear. A mere statement that an experiment was performed is not O.

in_vivo_status_source.description: Whether in_vivo_status was last set by the keyword heuristic (main.py's classify_evidence_presence) or overridden by a reviewer in the TAB3 table.

in_vitro_status.description: Same detection as in_vivo_status, for in-vitro efficacy evidence.

admet_completed.description: Count of 'Completed' occurrences found in attachments whose filename contains 'admet', out of a fixed denominator of 50 (main.py's count_admet_completed). Null when no admet-named attachment has been uploaded yet.

collaboration.description: Threaded reviewer comments attached to this record.

attachments.description: Original source files (PPT/PPTX/PDF/TXT/Word/Excel) uploaded from the detail page's partner-material dropzone. Each item: {id, filename, stored_path, content_type, size_bytes, uploaded_by, uploaded_at}.

qualitative_review.description: Researcher opinions keyed by qualitative-review criterion id (see config/qualitative_review_criteria.md), each with an entries array of {id, author, body, is_ai, created_at}. Entries with is_ai=true and author='AI' are genuine OpenRouter-generated first drafts (grounded in source_report.raw_markdown and uploaded attachments) produced via the 'AI 생성' button, shown in the UI with an [AI] badge. Entries authored 'AI (초안)' are legacy rule-based placeholders kept for data compatibility but hidden from the UI. custom_criteria is an array of user-registered additional criteria: {id, label, description, created_by, created_at}, id prefixed 'custom_'. Criteria imported from another record may additionally store imported_from_record_id and imported_from_criterion_id; only the definition is copied, never opinion entries.

rubric.description: 기준 설명 전용 섹션. scoring의 main_line_summary에는 이 기준 문구를 반복하지 않는다.

status.description: Full Scout uses PASS/REVIEW/FAIL; absence of direct Theme/Cluster fit alone is not an automatic FAIL. Fast Triage v3.2 uses SELECT/REJECT/UNVERIFIED, where UNVERIFIED is limited to an asset identity that cannot be verified from credible public sources. N/A and Unclear are legacy-read compatibility values and are not valid for new v3.2 Fast Triage output.

max_score.description: Full Scout uses 21. Fast Triage uses 9 only when total_score is used; otherwise both total_score and max_score are null.

status.description: N/A is accepted only for stored Fast Triage v3.1 compatibility. New v3.2 output uses UNVERIFIED.

active_asset.description: Required in Fast Triage v3.2: true only when active status is confirmed, false when inactive is confirmed, and null when activity cannot be established. SELECT requires true; identity failure uses UNVERIFIED.

evidence_sources.description: Fast Triage v3.2: only http(s) sources whose contents were actually opened and verified for this criterion. A user-supplied URL that was not opened is not verified evidence.

verified_evidence_sources.description: Optional explicit verified-source list. When present it is authoritative for verified source count instead of evidence_sources.

evidence_sources.description: Current Fast Triage evidence requires an opened/checked http(s) URL and explicit verified=true; unverified user-supplied URLs do not count.

A_targetable_addressable_patient.description: A. Targetable Addressable Patient (TAP): estimate the actually treatable patient pool.

B_unrisked_peak_sales.description: B. Unrisked Peak Sales: theoretical peak sales before full competition and execution risk adjustment. Sales output should be expressed in million USD.

sales_unit.description: Preferred display and storage unit for sales outputs.

C_obtainable_peak_sales.description: C. Obtainable Peak Sales: realistic commercial opportunity after competition, pricing power, and expansion adjustments. Sales output should be expressed in million USD.

sales_unit.description: Preferred display and storage unit for sales outputs.

source_report.description: Human-readable GPT report used as the primary raw source for downstream schema parsing.

company_profile.description: Basic company information and verification sources used before asset-level scoring.
